subject.title: Race condition (missing tool result / synthetic errors) still reproducible on 2026.6.11 AND 2026.7.1-beta.2 — supersedes closed #31664/#6682/#15008/#13286

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable long-running production-runner proof before treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97646 or a successor as the fix for this issue?
rationale: The source boundary matches the report, but the issue describes a long-session production race and the active candidate PR is still explicitly proof-gated.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the fix candidate.

options.title: Accept focused source/test proof
options.body: Maintainers can land the shared-helper change based on focused tests while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Pause for release audit first
options.body: A release owner can first answer the stable and beta gitHead/provenance question before deciding whether to land or backport the fix.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the fix candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the session guard and synthetic pending-result boundary that Peter introduced and recently touched.
